Our Story

From Nepali soil to your cup

RedMud takes its name from the rich, red earth of the Terai — and its coffee from Nepal's own hills. Every cup supports local growers first, not imports.

🌱

Locally grown, locally roasted flavour

We champion Nepali-grown coffee — fresher beans, a shorter journey, and money that stays with farming communities here in Nepal.

🤝

Young people, real jobs

RedMud is known for giving young people a start — training them as baristas, cooks and hosts, and building skills they can carry anywhere.

🍛

More than a coffee shop

Come for the coffee, stay for the food — our Thakali set and snacks make RedMud a proper meal stop at Mahabir Chowk, not just a quick caffeine fix.

The Signature

The Thakali set everyone talks about

A full Nepali thali in the Thakali tradition — balanced, filling and made for sharing the table.

Hero Dish · Sample

RedMud Thakali Set

Steaming rice with dal, seasonal tarkari, achar, greens and your choice of curry — served the traditional way, with refills of the good stuff.

  • Rice, dal & seasonal vegetables
  • Homestyle achar & fresh greens
  • Veg and non-veg options (sample)
  • Best paired with a hot Nepali coffee
